text:
jason_sales: Prospect 'ClearLedger' wants a 2-week POC. Requirements: EU-only tenancy, BYOK mandatory and keys must remain in eu-west-1, primary ireland with frankfurt as compute-only failover, subprocessors CSV for procurement, and a rough cost uplift for pinning. Can Dedicated meet this? cc @priya_platform @eli_ops

 priya_platform: Yes, Dedicated or Private. Hosted can't guarantee BYOK region-lock. For strict key residency + region-pin, Dedicated is recommended.

 eli_ops: Subprocessors quick list for procurement: AWS (eu-west-1, eu-central-1), GCP (europe-west3), Cloudflare, Fastly, Datadog, Sentry, HashiCorp Vault. I'll upload signed CSV to the presales folder.

 jason_sales: One-line KMS statement I can paste into their security questionnaire?

 security_bot: "Customer-managed keys supported on Dedicated/Private with HSM-backed BYOK. Hosted uses Redwood-managed keys by default; Hosted-BYOK available under addendum and extra attestation."

 priya_platform: Cost uplift note: tenant pinning means reserved capacity + sizing. Typical uplift: reservation fee + ~15-25% per-token cost increase; depends on peak rps and seq len. Share their expected peak rps and avg seq and I can give a ballpark.

 jason_sales: They estimate 25 rps, avg seq 100 tokens. Also: they need failover behavior documented: primary ireland, failover frankfurt only, but keys must not leave ireland. How do we handle that?

 priya_platform: If keys are region-locked to eu-west-1, failover to eu-central-1 will be blocked unless customer replicates keys or grants a contractual exception allowing secure wrapping in the failover region. Two options: (1) customer replicates keys to eu-central-1 (customer-managed), or (2) set failover to "blocked_if_key_unavailable" so requests error rather than cross-region. Both options must be explicit in MSA addendum.

 priya_platform: Minimal routing policy example to share with infra team:

 { "tenant": "clearledger-poc", "routing_mode": "tenant_pin", "primary": "eu-west-1", "failover": ["eu-central-1"], "failover_behavior": "blocked_if_key_unavailable" , "kms": "byok_hsm_region_locked:eu-west-1" }

 priya_platform: Sizing rough: 25 rps * 100 tokens = 2500 tokens/sec (~150k tokens/min). For 50-60ms p95 we'd target a dedicated GPU pool with low-concurrency shapes; estimate 1 reserved GPU + 1 standby. Ballpark uplift: reservation ~$5k/mo + token uplift ~18-22%. Exact quote needs qps and model choice.

 eli_ops: Ops timeline: Dedicated tenant provisioning 5-8 business days after PO + capacity allocation. BYOK HSM import & attestation +3-7 business days. Need from customer: CIDR (if VPC), BYOK key material or replication plan, and confirmation of failover behavior choice.

 jason_sales: Can you drop a tiny latency test script I can share so they can validate p95 from their EU office before kickoff?

 priya_platform: Simple curl loop (bash):

 for i in {1..150}; do
   t0=$(date +%s%3N)
   curl -s -X POST https://eu.api.redwood.example/v1/chat -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"input":"ping"}' >/dev/null
   t1=$(date +%s%3N)
   echo $((t1-t0))
 done | sort -n | awk 'NR==int(0.95*NR){print "p95:"$1}'

 eli_ops: I'll create the presales ticket and attach subprocessors CSV + EU attestation pack. Ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/POC-3388.

 jason_sales: Thanks — I'll get the CIDR and key replication answer from the customer and update the ticket. :thumbsup:
